purpose: CI hardening and required-check gate documentation

controls.name: least_privilege_permissions
controls.risk: Overbroad CI token permissions increase supply-chain blast radius.

controls.name: checkout_credentials_not_persisted
controls.risk: Persisted credentials can be abused by later steps.

controls.name: job_timeout_defined
controls.risk: Missing timeout can allow CI resource exhaustion.

controls.name: concurrency_defined
controls.risk: Unbounded concurrent runs waste resources and obscure signal.

controls.name: unit_tests_required
controls.evidence: workflow runs python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v
controls.risk: Missing test gate allows broken evidence artifacts.

controls.name: security_checkers_required
controls.evidence: workflow runs all WVP Nightfall checkers
controls.risk: Missing checker steps reduce verification coverage.

controls.name: release_pack_required
controls.risk: Evidence bundle can drift from manifest.

controls.name: ci_hardening_self_check_required
controls.risk: CI hardening policy can silently regress.

controls.name: branch_protection_template_exists
controls.risk: Required checks may not be configured consistently.

controls.name: required_check_documentation_exists
controls.risk: Maintainers may not know which check must be required.

controls.name: non_audit_boundary_preserved
controls.evidence: CI hardening reports include non-audit boundary
controls.risk: Evidence checks may be misrepresented as audit certification.

controls.name: no_secret_or_live_fund_dependency
controls.evidence: workflow does not require secrets, seeds, private keys, wallets, or live funds
controls.risk: CI should remain safe for public forks and pull requests.

boundary: This creates CI hardening evidence and branch-protection guidance. It does not itself enable GitHub branch protection, merge PRs, or prove project safety.
